Affordable ERP for Oilfield Services Companies 2026

An honest 2026 ERP comparison for oilfield-services companies — well services, completions, intervention, frac, cementing, directional drilling, wireline logging, downhole tools, frac rentals. Atlantis NDT ERP regional pricing flat vs Quorum, Enverus PRISM, Peloton WellView, P2 Energy. IADC / OPITO / NORSOK D-010 / API Q1/Q2 native, Halliburton / SLB / BHG / Aramco APQS / ADNOC Tejari portal integration.

Oilfield-services contractors operate at the intersection of three demanding domains: IADC / OPITO / NORSOK competency frameworks for personnel; API Spec Q1 / Q2 / 4F / 5CT / 6A / 7-1 quality-management systems for tools and equipment; and operator-specific qualification regimes (Saudi Aramco SAEP-1112 / SAEP-1119, ADNOC AGES, KOC Field Operations, Petrobras Diretrizes Operacionais) that change between operators and even between operator divisions. Generic enterprise platforms (Quorum, Enverus, Peloton, P2 Energy) handle parts of this but at enterprise cost levels that exclude most independent OFS contractors below $20M revenue.

Atlantis NDT ERP OFS deployment ships with IADC / OPITO / NORSOK / API Q1 workflow pre-built and operator vendor-portal integration native — affordable, accessible, fully customizable, with one all-in fee covering the whole ERP stack. Pricing varies by region; quote on request at info@atlantisndt.com.
